decisions.reason: The safety shoe line is core business for a large protective-footwear maker, and with no reported shortfall against aspirations there is nothing to trigger problemistic search, while slack lets the firm carry it.

The comfort insole is a low-cost complement to shoe sales, but it gets only a mention and overlaps with the flagship moulded insole, and C has already been cut, so further consolidation of the insole range is a moderate risk rather than a likely step this year.
The ergonomic series has its own page and fits the firm's innovation direction, so management would keep carrying it while its results are still forming.
Firefighter and rescue boots serve a stable, certification-driven niche with long procurement cycles, so two years is too short to judge them against aspirations and slack lets the firm keep them.
As the home-page flagship, the moulded insole carries strong strategic commitment and is likely the insole that benefits from the earlier consolidation, so a withdrawal is very unlikely.
